decisions.reason: As a visible extension of the core platform that has already been retained once, it benefits from added sunk investment, public commitment, and a good fit with the firm's central digital-operations strategy.

Although narrower because it is gas-focused, it remains close to the established offer and its continued standalone presence makes management inclined to justify prior investment rather than withdraw it now.

This calculator directly uses the firm's core market-data and calculation capabilities, and after surviving the first review it is likely to be kept as part of the announced integrated platform direction.
Even as more of an enabling tool than a flagship product, it supports the broader platform architecture and accumulated commitment still makes continuation more likely than exit.
